title: Bedmap3 updated ice bed, surface and thickness gridded datasets for Antarctica (Pritchard and others, 2025)

source.license: CC BY 4.0 (stated in the PDF and on the Nature page)

summary: Describes Bedmap3, a gridded set of ice thickness, bed and surface elevation for Antarctica. It is the data behind any claim about what lies under the ice, including the Antarctic Atlantis idea.

tool.name: PageIndex
tool.method: PageIndex Flash mode run through Claude Code (claude-code/haiku; doc_id pi-94154f8270d54192bee4a8877425057a; store in out/pageindex). The tree follows the paper's own headings. I replaced PageIndex's model-written summaries, which contained numbers I could not stand behind, with short summaries of what each section covers, and tidied titles. Text is the PDF text layer by page.

tree.title: Bedmap3 updated ice bed, surface and thickness gridded datasets for Antarctica
tree.summary: The whole data descriptor: Bedmap3, gridded surface elevation, ice thickness and bed elevation for Antarctica south of 60 degrees south, built from many new surveys.
